title: ardisia opegrapha subsp. wagneri
intro: Ardisia opegrapha subsp. wagneri, commonly known as the Pacific ardisia, is a species of flowering plant in the family Primulaceae. This plant is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin problems. The health benefits of Ardisia opegrapha subsp. wagneri include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions of reducing pain and fighting infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
